description: REQUIRES prior nhis_edi__session__login call with same account_link_id. Issue an NHIS payment-completion (완납증명서) or payment (납부확인서) certificate. IRREVERSIBLE: the certificate is issued at 건강보험공단 and an issue number is assigned; there is no cancel action. This writes to the institution. The first call is not executed: it returns a preview of exactly what will be sent and a one-time confirmation_token (error WRITE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Show that preview to the user as it is. Only after the user agrees, call again with the same arguments plus that confirmation_token. Never add the token without the user's agreement. Changing any argument makes the token invalid; call without the token to get a new preview. Files: the document the institution issued, unchanged, as PDF, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links. For an anonymous result, keep its private recovery_receipt and send it with the original job_id or pack_run_id to xdata__job__result. It grants access to that result only, until the original file retention expires. Do not publish it. Losing it cannot be repaired by signing up. The receipt also works if the client later signs in; it does not grant access to other results. Without a receipt, results require the original account and lane. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: 연동 ID(UUID v4). 선택 입력입니다. 비워 두면 서버가 API 키로 연동을 찾아 씁니다. 같은 기관에 인증서를 여러 개 연동했을 때만 직접 입력해 주세요. 기관마다 ID 가 다릅니다.

confirmation_token.description: 첫 호출이 돌려준 1회용 확인 토큰입니다(오류 WRITE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). 같은 인자에 이 값을 그대로 넣어 다시 호출하면 실행됩니다. 10분 뒤 만료되고 한 번만 쓸 수 있습니다.

year.description: Target year YYYY (payment_certificate only). Defaults to the current year.
